analysis: The two supplied units are base-side text of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 7656-8515). The file_changes patch shows head-side edits only at base lines 453 and 3219-3221, which are outside these units. Nothing in the examined text was changed, so there is no new behavior to evaluate here and no concrete regression to cite. The content is architecture documentation: MiMo, Qwen TP, Gemma and GPT-OSS batch/decode scheduling, content-free size-only diagnostic logs, placement pricing, and Qwen media transport. It states that no serving grant, media advertisement or qualification is enabled by these items. The T-041 prefix-cache text ties to cluster prefix tenant partitions, but the visible lines make no security-relevant claim that conflicts with the retained definition. They only note that prefix reuse is off for MiMo page paths, and that Qwen TP prefixes use the memory and SSD tiers keyed by each request's own partition. The changed hunk (cluster onboarding stop-count handling, `ClusterControlReply.stopsAsked`, `darkbloom cluster stop`) is only partially visible in the truncated patch excerpt and not in these units. Next review passes should check that part, including the stop-count comparison across Macs, the authentication of the control reply on the cluster channel, and the command lock. Any weakening of authentication on that cluster control channel would need to be judged against the existing trust boundaries. No finding is raised from these units. A full audit is not claimed.
